body.message:
Good morning Michael,

I hope you’re doing well.

As today is your check-in date, please note that our check-in time starts from 3:00 PM. We kindly request you to complete the payment before check-in so we can proceed with the check-in process.

Once the payment is received, we will share the full apartment details with you, including the unit number and access information. As this is a self-check-in, you can simply proceed directly to the building.

Thank you for your cooperation, and we look forward to welcoming you.
